raw_segments.text: After Wicklow lain the window of Madame Doyle, court dress milliner, stopped him.
He stood looking in at the two puckers stripped to their pelts and
putting up their props.
From the side mirrors to mourning, masters dignum gaped silently.
Myler Keog, Dublin's pet lamb, will meet Sergent Major Bennett,
the portobello bruiser for a purse of 50 sovereigns.
Gob, that'd be a good pucking match to see.
Myler Keog, that's the chap sparring out to him with the green sash.
Two bar entrance, soldiers half price.
I could easy do a bunk on maw.
Master dignum on his left turned as he turned.
That's me in mourning.
When is it?
May the Twentice conned.
Sure, the blooming thing is all over.
He turned to the right and on his right,
master dignum turned, his cap awry, his collar sticking up.
Butting it down, his chin lifted.
He saw the image of Marie Kendall, charming subret, beside the two puckers.
One of them mows that do be in the packets of fags, stow, or smokes.
That his old fellow welted hell out of him, for one time he found out.
